title: The Fungus That Forces Ants to Climb a Leaf and Die

scenes.text: A fungus forces ants to climb a leaf and die.
It infects carpenter ants in tropical forests, and they climb about ten inches off the ground.
At solar noon, the ant clamps its jaws into the main vein of a leaf.
The fungus locks its jaw, and the ant dies about six hours later.
Two or three days later, a stalk grows out of the ant's head and releases spores.
The ant never chose it, and the fungus picked the exact spot and time.

description:

Infected carpenter ants bite the main vein of a leaf at solar noon, die about six hours later, and a fungal stalk grows from the head two or three days after.
Creepy or amazing?
